hold_prompt.doc: M3-C09-05 (act1_ch09.md §9 UI 1; shared with act3_ending E4): the held-input prompt a CutsceneHoldGate shows between <<event hold_input>> and <<event hold_input_end>>. One small plate, centred bottom_px above the bottom of the screen (the gate's own data may set bottom_px instead): a keycap with the held action's binding for the device used last (its first key, or its first pad button; InputNames, generic names, no brand glyphs) and the verb ("Hold to raise the staff"). There is no meter, no count and no fail state: holding only lights the keycap (held_fill, held_border palette roles), and letting go lets the plate breathe, its alpha easing between breath_low and 1 over breath_sec (reduced motion: steady at 1), while the dance waits. It fades in and out over fade_sec. Pixels are at the 1920 x 1080 reference; plate: sep_px between keycap and verb; keycap: min_width, border_px, radius_px, pad_x.
